+showStartOfTurn(view : ManagerView, stateView : StateView, tableView : TableView, result : Result) : void
-targetRow(label : String, value : String, need : String, met : boolean) : String
-readInt(prompt : String, min : int, max : int) : OptionalInt
+validateNumber(input : String, min : int, max : int) : ChoiceValidator.Result
+seatProcess(waiter : Waiter, customer : Customer, table : Table) : void
+seatProcess(host : Host, customer : Customer, table : Table) : void
-seat(customer : Customer, table : Table, seatingAction : Runnable) : void
+processNewOrder(waiter : Waiter, customer : Customer, menu : List<MenuItem>, combos : List<MenuItem>) : void

Restaurant and Customer call them through a Customer
reference and never check the type, so a new customer
type needs no change to Restaurant or GameController
Restaurant creates its 2 Tables and its HappyHour itself,
and they exist only as part of that Restaurant.
The tables array is never handed out (getTables returns
a copy), and HappyHour is private: other classes reach it
